cases.why: MLB's pages are never built in the browser job, so nothing in a real browser looks at them before Stage 101 publishes them
the hidden check opens the other sports' pages but not MLB's, so an empty box marked hidden is drawn on MLB's unseen
mlb.js drops the rule that runs fitTables, so a Model Lab table wider than a phone cannot be reached by keyboard (axe scrollable-region-focusable)
